27645-the-beginning.title: The Beginning
27645-the-beginning.creator: Henry Hasse
27645-the-beginning.description: A book by Henry Hasse. An atom is dissected, a belly rumbles in hunger, a star blooms into brief nova; a bird wheels in futile escape, an ice-flow impacts, an equation is expressed in awesome mushrooming shape. These are multitudinous, apocalyptic. They are timeless and equal. These are things whereby suns wheel or blossom or die, a tribe vanishes, a civilization climbs or a world decays._

arxiv-2101-06907.title: Quartic Perturbation-based Outage-constrained Robust Design in Two-hop One-way Relay Networks
arxiv-2101-06907.creator: Sissi Xiaoxiao Wu, Sherry Xue-Ying Ni, Jiaying Li, Anthony Man-Cho So
arxiv-2101-06907.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Sissi Xiaoxiao Wu, Sherry Xue-Ying Ni, Jiaying Li, Anthony Man-Cho So. In this work, we study a classic robust design problem in two-hop one-way relay system. We are particularly interested in the scenario where channel uncertainty exists in both the transmitter-to-relay and relay-to-receiver links. By considering the problem design that minimizes the average amplify-and-forward power budget at the relay side while satisfying SNR outage requirements, an outage-constrained robust design problem involving quartic perturbations is formulated to guarantee the robustness during transmission.

arxiv-2110-07744.title: Constrained Covariance Steering Based Tube-MPPI
arxiv-2110-07744.creator: Isin M. Balci, Efstathios Bakolas, Bogdan Vlahov, Evangelos A. Theodorou
arxiv-2110-07744.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Isin M. Balci, Efstathios Bakolas, Bogdan Vlahov, Evangelos A. Theodorou. In this paper, we present a new trajectory optimization algorithm for stochastic linear systems which combines Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control with Constrained Covariance Steering (CSS) to achieve high performance with safety guarantees (robustness). Although MPPI can be used to solve complex nonlinear trajectory optimization problems, it may not always handle constraints effectively and its performance may degrade in the presence of unmodeled disturbances.

arxiv-2310-20176.title: Predicting Astrometric Microlensing Events from Gaia DR3 2015 Predicting Astrometric Microlensing Events from Gaia DR3 – References
arxiv-2310-20176.creator: Jie Su, Jiancheng Wang, Yigong Zhang Xiangming Cheng, Lei Yang
arxiv-2310-20176.description: Abstract Currently astrometric microlensing is the only tool that can directly measure the mass of a single star, it can also help us to detect compact objects like isolated neutron stars and black holes. The number of microlensing events that are being predicted and reported is increasing.

arxiv-2311-07682.title: Fuse to Forget: Bias Reduction and Selective Memorization through Model Fusion
arxiv-2311-07682.creator: Kerem Zaman, Leshem Choshen, Shashank Srivastava
arxiv-2311-07682.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Kerem Zaman, Leshem Choshen, Shashank Srivastava. Model fusion research aims to aggregate the knowledge of multiple individual models to enhance performance by combining their weights. In this work, we study the inverse problem: investigating whether model fusion can be used to reduce unwanted knowledge. We investigate the effects of model fusion in three scenarios: the learning of shortcuts, social biases, and memorization of training data in fine-tuned language models.

arxiv-2408-00747.title: Crochet Representation of the Lobachevskian Surface
arxiv-2408-00747.creator: Isabella Estrada Reyes, Adriana Mejia Castaño
arxiv-2408-00747.description: Abstract Beginning the study of non-Euclidean geometries, physical models or representations, such as crochet ones, provide a tangible portrayal of these advanced mathematical concepts. However, their connection to local Euclidean surfaces still needs further investigation. This work aims to explore how the characteristics of crochet models relate to non-Euclidean concepts by providing a parametrization of such surfaces.

arxiv-2408-05461.title: Dynamical behaviour of a Soap Film Bridge driven by an Electrostatic Force
arxiv-2408-05461.creator: Lina Sophie Schmitz
arxiv-2408-05461.description: Abstract . We study a free boundary problem describing a tubular soap film bridge driven by an electrostatic force. To realize the electrostatic force, the soap film bridge is placed inside an outer metal cylinder and a voltage difference between this cylinder and the soap film is applied.

arxiv-2503-03739.title: Observables and Unconstrained Spin Tensor Dynamics in General Relativity from Scattering Amplitudes
arxiv-2503-03739.creator: Mark Alaverdian, Zvi Bern, Dimitrios Kosmopoulos, Andres Luna, Radu Roiban, Trevor Scheopner, Fei Teng
arxiv-2503-03739.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Mark Alaverdian, Zvi Bern, Dimitrios Kosmopoulos, Andres Luna, Radu Roiban, Trevor Scheopner, Fei Teng. In a previous Letter, we showed that physical scattering observables for compact spinning objects in general relativity can depend on additional degrees of freedom in the spin tensor beyond those described by the spin vector alone.

arxiv-2508-01114.title: Verification of the NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center solar flare forecast (1998-2024)
arxiv-2508-01114.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by . The NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center (SWPC) issues the official U.S. government forecast for M-class and X-class solar flares, yet the skill of these forecasts has never been comprehensively verified. In this study, we evaluate the SWPC probabilistic flare forecasts over a 26-year period (1998–2024), comparing them to several zero-cost and statistical baselines including persistence, climatology, Naive Bayes, and logistic regression.

arxiv-2509-07812.title: Unlocking Stopped-Rotor Flight: Development and Validation of SPERO, a Novel UAV Platform
arxiv-2509-07812.creator: Kristan Hilby, Ian Hunter
arxiv-2509-07812.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Kristan Hilby, Ian Hunter. Stop-rotor aircraft have long been proposed as the ideal vertical takeoff and landing (VTOL) aircraft for missions with equal time spent in both flight regimes, such as agricultural monitoring, search and rescue, and last-mile delivery. Featuring a central lifting surface that rotates in VTOL to generate vertical thrust and locks in forward flight to generate passive lift, the stop-rotor offers the potential for high efficiency across both modes.

pmc-10624354.creator: Wenrong Tan, Junhua Chen, Xiaolan Yue, Shuli Chai, Wei Liu, Chenglin Li, Feng Yang, Yongfeng Gao, Lucas Gutiérrez Rodríguez, Víctor Resco de Dios, Dawei Zhang, Yinan Yao
pmc-10624354.description: During summer, plants often experience increased light inputs and high temperatures, two major environmental factors with contrasting effects on thermomorphological traits. The integration of light and temperature signaling to control thermomorphogenesis in plants is critical for their acclimation in such conditions, but the underlying mechanisms remain largely unclear.

pmc-12387635.title: Analysis of the Microstructure and Mechanical Properties of Austenitic Stainless Steel 310 Manufactured via WAAM
pmc-12387635.creator: Aline Cipriano, Célia de Fraga Malfatti, Henrique Cechinel Casagrande, Anderson Daleffe, Jovani Castelan, Pedro Henrique Menegaro Possamai
pmc-12387635.description: The objective of this study was to characterize austenitic stainless steel 310 produced by Wire and Arc Additive Manufacturing (WAAM), addressing a gap in the literature regarding this alloy. Microstructural, chemical, and mechanical analyses were performed. Optical and electron microscopy revealed a predominantly columnar grain structure with characteristic tracks along the deposition direction.

pmc-13107096.title: KRAS (G12D)-selective inhibitor MRTX1133 suppresses proliferation and differentially modulates chemosensitivity in ovarian mucinous carcinoma
pmc-13107096.creator: Ryota Watano, Hiroaki Mizukami, Yasushi Saga
pmc-13107096.description: Ovarian mucinous carcinoma (OMC) is a rare subtype of ovarian cancer characterized by frequent KRAS mutations and a poor response to platinum- and taxane-based chemotherapy, underscoring the need for novel therapeutic strategies. MRTX1133, a recently developed non-covalent and selective KRAS (G12D) inhibitor, has demonstrated potent antitumor activity in pancreatic and colorectal cancers; however, its efficacy in OMC remains unexplored.

pmc-13368840.title: Paraesophageal hernia repair is associated with similar safety and efficacy results in octogenarians as compared to younger patients
pmc-13368840.creator: Kayvan Barekatain, Emily F Simon, Joshua L Lyons, Natalie N Chakraborty, Christina S Boutros, Trisha Lal, Jill Knepprath, Ayesha Siddiq, Hamza N Chatha, Saher-Zahra S Khan, Patrick M Wieland, Sami O Abul-Khoudoud, Nicolette M Winder, Samuel J Zolin, Jeffrey Marks
pmc-13368840.description: BackgroundNational database studies suggest elective paraesophageal hernia (PEH) repair in octogenarians is safe but provide limited detail on operative strategy and long-term symptom outcomes. We evaluated perioperative outcomes, operative strategy, and post-discharge functional outcomes in octogenarians undergoing PEH repair compared with younger patients in a contemporary institutional cohort.

pmc-13460694.description: OBJECTIVE:Hip fractures are associated with moderate-to-severe pain, which is frequently managed inadequately in emergency departments (EDs).
